propositions: rebar transition in_progress closed reports a lock error to stderr with exit code 0 approximately 60 seconds after the close durably commits, silently dropping the completion signature
the STATUS event commits and releases the lock before the signing tail runs, so a transient lock timeout during signature append fails to report a successful close
the return payload carries no field about signature outcome, making the loss undetectable programmatically by library, CLI, or MCP consumers
the exception handler justifies exit-0 degrade for missing ssh-keygen (permanent, operator-fixable) but applies to transient lock timeout (should fail noisily)

close_ticket must return completion_signature {signed, cause, error} with closed vocabulary (signed / sign_failed / material_drifted / force_bypassed) to make the loss machine-readable and honestly worded without changing exit code

the completion_signature key must be absent for non-close transitions and for idea -> closed (not a completion), and must be threaded through _lib_writes.transition, CLI --output json, TransitionResult TypedDict, and transition_result.schema.json
